RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, November 19, 2010/Kartika 28, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Human Resource Development; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
44
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Opposition to semester
system
*141. SHRI SHYAMAL
CHAKRABORTY: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Delhi
University has introduced semester system
in 13 under-graduate science courses;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Delhi
University Teachers’ Association (DUTA)
is protesting against the semester system;
and
(c) if so, what amicable settlement the
Ministry is making to reign in DUTA on
semester system?
Commercialisation of education
†*142. SHRI RAGHUNANDAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of
HUMANRESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
commercialisation of education is taking
place rapidly;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to check this
commercialisation?
Impact of floods and drought on
agriculture products
*143. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has made any
assessment about the losses suffered by
States and farmers due to the recent floods
in different parts of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps taken by Government to
extend the required financial and other
assistance to the affected States;
(d) whether it is a fact that a large number
of districts were also adversely affected
due to drought during the last kharif season;
and
(e) if so, the details of the districts and
the losses suffered by each district and the
nature of assistance given by the Central
Government?

45
Assistance to displaced persons from
mining areas
*144. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of STEEL be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the steel
making companies in the country have been
asked to give 26 per cent profits from
mining for displaced persons of mining
areas;
(b) if so, the details thereof;  and
(c) how this provision is likely to be
implemented?
Criteria for fixing MSP
†*145. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that at the end of
the current year Government proposes to
increase the Minimum Support Prices
(MSP) of agricultural products of rabi
crops to arrive after April, 2011;
(b) if so, the names of the products and
the amount of increase in their value;
and
(c) the reasons for not adopting similar
criteria for increasing Minimum Support
Prices of all the agricultural products?
Implementation of Village Grain
Bank Scheme
*146. SHRI BHAGAT SINGH
KOSHYARI: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) the details regarding the guidelines
issued by Government for implementation
of Village Grain Bank Scheme;
(b) whether the targets fixed for setting
up of Village Grain Banks during the Tenth
Five Year Plan have been achieved;
(c) if so, the details of the targets fixed
and achieved during the said period,
State-wise;
(d) the details of targets fixed by
Government for Eleventh Five Year Plan,
State-wise; and
(e) the steps taken to achieve the said
targets?
Formation of students' unions in
Central Universities
†*147. SHRI MOHAN SINGH: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Central Universities
as on date;
(b) the universities where students’
unions are in existence and the number of
universities where demand for formation
of students' union is pending;
(c) whether Government is considering
to constitute students’ union as per the
directions of Supreme Court and the
recommendations of Lyngdoh Committee
in all such universities;  and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Allocation of fertilizers to States
†*148. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any concrete steps have
been taken by Government to prevent the
hoarding of fertilizers;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

46
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether, in view of growing demand
for fertilizers with nutrients, Government
has worked on any plan to supply adequate
amount of fertilizers; and
(d) if so, the details of the quantity of
fertilizers allocated to various States so far?
Shifting of DRM office from Kalupur
to Sabarmati

THAKOR: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:

order to the General Manager (G.M.),
Western Railways with regard to shifting
of Divisional Railway Manager (DRM)
office from Kalupur to Sabarmati Railway
Station area;
